2609.39843.title: BayesNDE: Bayesian Generative Modeling for Neural Density Estimation
2609.39843.paper_summary: Density estimation is a fundamental problem in statistics and machine learning. In this work, we introduce BayesNDE, a neural density estimator based on Bayesian generative modeling. BayesNDE learns a Bayesian generative model and evaluates its density without requiring invertible networks or Jacobian-determinant computation. For each observation, it infers a sample-specific latent posterior to construct an adaptive proposal that focuses computation on regions contributing most to its density. Bridge sampling then combines samples from this proposal with separate posterior samples to estimate the density. Experiments on nonlinear and multimodal synthetic datasets show improved estimation of density values and better recovery of the density structure compared to the state-of-the-art neural density estimators. Applications to real-world datasets further demonstrate improved anomaly detection. Together, these results highlight BayesNDE as a flexible and effective neural density estimator, demonstrating how posterior inference can turn generative models into tools for density estimation. The code and tutorials are available at https://github.com/liuq-lab/BayesNDE.
2609.39843.paper_summary_zh: 密度估計是統計學和機器學習中的一個基本問題。<lb/>在這項工作中，我們介紹了BayesNDE，一種基於貝葉斯生成建模的神經密度估計器。<lb/>BayesNDE學習一個貝葉斯生成模型，並在不需要可逆網絡或雅可比行列式計算的情況下評估其密度。<lb/>對於每個觀察，它推斷一個樣本特定的潛在後驗，以構建一個自適應提案，將計算重點放在對其密度貢獻最大的區域。<lb/>橋接取樣然後將來自這個提案的樣本與單獨的後驗樣本結合，以估計密度。<lb/>在非線性和多模態合成數據集上的實驗顯示，與最先進的神經密度估計器相比，密度值的估計得到了改善，密度結構的恢復也更好。<lb/>對現實世界數據集的應用進一步展示了改進的異常檢測。<lb/>綜合這些結果，突顯了BayesNDE作為一個靈活且有效的神經密度估計器，展示了後驗推斷如何將生成模型轉變為密度估計的工具。<lb/>代碼和教程可在 https://github.com/liuq-lab/BayesNDE 獲得。
